_comment: Hand-checked corporate-action inputs for research/py/nse_build.py prices. 'drop' removes a parsed NSE record (symbol, ex, kind, why); 'add' adds one NSE's records miss (symbol, ex, kind, det, why; a demerger may carry det.factor); 'real_moves' records large daily moves left in the adjusted series that are genuine trading, with the evidence.

add.why: NSE's record reads 'Agm/Spl/Bon-1:1/Div-20%': a split with no ratio plus a 1:1 bonus. The record's face value is Rs 5 (Rs 10 before), and the raw price fell 75% that day, which the bonus alone (50%) does not explain.

real_moves.why: Satyam's chairman disclosed the accounting fraud on 2009-01-07; the stock fell 78% on the 7th and kept falling. Intraday on heavy volume.
Rebound after the government moved to replace Satyam's board (2009-01-09 evening).
2009-05-18 general-election result day: the whole market hit its upper circuit and trading was halted (Nifty +17.7%).
2009-05-18 general-election result day, market-wide upper circuit.
2009-05-18 general-election result day, market-wide upper circuit.
COVID crash: Nifty 50 fell 12.98% on 2020-03-23; ISEC closed at its 20% lower circuit.
Closed at its 20% upper circuit (close equals high, 3.4 times the previous day's volume); no corporate action that month.
